input.quote: 10.5 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: Section 10.5 selects New York law, which is our preferred governing law under GOVLAW. The document contains no arbitration clause and no foreign seat or forum-selection provision (searches for "arbitration", "courts", "venue" and "dispute" return nothing relevant), so there is no walk-away risk of vendor-home-jurisdiction venue or offshore arbitration. The only shortfall against the preferred wording is the absence of an express exclusive-jurisdiction stipulation to the state and federal courts in New York County; that is a missing venue mechanic rather than a material term failure, so we note it without redlining. If the agreement is otherwise being amended, we could add the New York County exclusive-venue sentence as a housekeeping point.
